description: This file contains functions for managing a 'todos' table in a PostgreSQL database. It includes schema creation, CRUD operations, and connection management for a FastAPI backend project.

methods.name: str get_dsn()
methods.description: Returns the hardcoded PostgreSQL DSN string used for database connection, with a fixed user, password, host, port, and database.

methods.name: psycopg.Connection _connect()
methods.description: Establishes and returns a new database connection using the DSN provided by get_dsn().

methods.name: None ensure_schema()
methods.description: Creates the 'todos' table and a trigger function to automatically update 'updated_at' timestamp on row modifications.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] query_all_todos()
methods.description: Retrieves all todo records from the database ordered by ID.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] query_todo_by_id(todo_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a single todo record by its ID, returning None if not found.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] insert_todo(title: str, description: str = "", completed: bool = False)
methods.description: Inserts a new todo record with given title, description, and completion status, returning the inserted row.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update_todo( todo_id: int, title: Optional[str] = None, description: Optional[str] = None, completed: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Updates specified fields of an existing todo identified by ID. Returns the updated record or None if not found.

methods.name: bool delete_todo(todo_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a todo record by ID, returning True if deletion occurred.

ctags.name: insert_todo
ctags.pattern: /^def insert_todo(title: str, description: str = "", completed: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
ctags.signature: (title: str, description: str = "", completed: bool = False)

ctags.name: update_todo
ctags.signature: ( todo_id: int, title: Optional[str] = None, description: Optional[str] = None, completed: Optional[bool] = None, )
